watches.name: AC2 Volcán Bronze Bloodstone
watches.description: The AC2 Volcán represents a bold refinement in our design journey, uniting organic character with timeless sophistication. Crafted with a 37mm bronze case and an ultra-slim profile, this timepiece carries a warm, enduring presence that develops a unique patina over time. Its natural bloodstone dial unfolds in deep forest green, flecked with vivid red, creating a striking play of texture and depth, highlighted by faceted hour markers and brushed dauphine hands. Driven by a precise Japanese quartz movement, the AC2 Volcán is both dependable and distinctive. watches.name: AC1 Chronograph Mother Of Pearl
watches.description: An evolution of the brand's inaugural chronograph, featuring a redesigned case, elevated finishing, genuine natural stone dials, Dauphine hands, and Swiss Super-LumiNova® Göteborg, Sweden – August 2026 : Anders & Co Timepieces proudly introduces the new AC1 Chronograph , a comprehensive evolution of the watch that launched the brand. While preserving the proportions and identity of the original, the new AC1 has been thoughtfully refined with a redesigned case, enhanced finishing, upgraded functionality, and a striking collection of genuine natural stone dials. Crafted from 316L stainless steel, the case retains its balanced dimensions of 38 mm in diameter, 11.3 mm thick, with a 46 mm lug-to-lug length and a 20 mm lug width . While the proportions remain unchanged, numerous details throughout the case have been carefully reworked. Subtle adjustments to the profile, lug geometry, bezel transitions, and surface finishing create a noticeably more refined appearance, with sharper definition between brushed and polished surfaces that enhances the watch from every angle. Further improvements include the addition of drilled lugs for effortless strap changes and an upgraded 5 ATM (50 metres) water resistance , making the AC1 better suited for everyday wear without compromising its elegant profile. The dial has also been elevated with faceted Dauphine hands filled with Swiss Super-LumiNova® , providing excellent legibility in low-light conditions while complementing the watch's timeless chronograph design. Genuine Natural Stone Dials The new AC1 Chronograph is offered with five genuine natural stone dials, each individually selected and finished to showcase the unique characteristics of the material. No two dials are ever identical. "The AC1 was the watch that started everything for Anders & Co. As we've grown, so have our expectations for what our watches should be. Rather than redesigning the AC1 entirely, we focused on refining every detail—improving the case architecture, elevating the finishing, enhancing functionality, and introducing materials that give every watch its own personality. The result is a chronograph that remains unmistakably AC1 while representing the craftsmanship and attention to detail we've developed over the years." Powered by the reliable Seiko VK64 meca-quartz chronograph movement and protected by a double-domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, the new AC1 Chronograph continues Anders & Co's philosophy of creating limited-production timepieces that combine thoughtful design, premium materials, and exceptional value. Specifications: Case Material: 316L stainless steel Case Diameter: 38 mm Case Thickness: 11.3 mm Lug Width: 20mm/46 mm lug to lug Movement: VK64 Mechanical Quartz Finishes: Features mirror polish and satin-brushed surfaces. Crystal: Scratch resistant double-domed sapphire crystal, anti-reflective coating. Case Back: Secured with a closed screw down case-back. Water Resistance: 5 ATM

watches.name: AC2 Volcán 35mm Enamel Lacquer Sand
watches.description: The AC2 Volcán 35mm celebrates the enduring appeal of classic watchmaking through a lens of timeless restraint. Inspired by the elegant proportions of mid century dress watches, its balanced 35mm case offers a versatile presence on the wrist, substantial enough for everyday wear yet faithful to the refined sizing that defined an earlier era of horology. Available in three rich enamel lacquer dial variations in deep blue, burgundy, and warm sand, the Volcán pairs traditional craftsmanship with distinctive character. Each dial showcases the remarkable depth and luminosity that only enamel can provide, creating a surface that shifts beautifully with changing light. Elegant Breguet numerals complete the composition, bringing a sense of classical sophistication and timeless legibility. The harmonious interplay of color, texture, and proportion gives the Volcán a quiet confidence. Firmly rooted in traditional watchmaking, its thoughtful palette offers a contemporary interpretation of a vintage aesthetic, making it equally at home with formal attire or everyday wear. At 35mm, the Volcán strikes a perfect balance between heritage and versatility. It is a watch designed not to follow trends, but to outlast them, an expression of considered design and understated elegance. Limited Production Run. watches.name: AC2 Volcán Manual Wind Salmon
watches.description: The AC2 Volcán Manual Wind introduces mechanical watchmaking to Anders & Co for the first time—an important evolution that builds on the brand’s established focus on proportion, materiality, and restraint. This execution features an enamel salmon dial, offering a rich and expressive surface with natural depth and luster. The warmth of the tone, combined with the clarity of the AC2 layout, creates a balance between character and discipline—allowing the watch to stand out while remaining cohesive within the collection. Inside, the ETA 7001 manual wind movement provides a fitting mechanical foundation. Known for its slim construction and reliability, it enables the watch to maintain a thickness of just 6.65mm, including the display caseback. Its inclusion reflects a broader philosophy: to pair thoughtful design with proven, enduring mechanics. The case is hand-finished in stainless steel, combining brushed planes with polished details to enhance its geometry. Equal care is given to the hands and applied indices, which are precisely finished to complement the dial and ensure a consistent level of refinement throughout. Produced in very limited quantities, the AC2 Volcán Manual Wind in enamel lacquer salmon represents both a continuation and a progression—introducing mechanical depth while staying true to the principles that define Anders & Co. watches.name: AC2 Volcán Manual Wind White
watches.description: The AC2 Volcán Manual Wind represents the first mechanical chapter for Anders & Co, bringing a new dimension to the collection while maintaining the clarity and discipline of its design language. The textured white dial offers a refined and highly legible execution. Its subtle surface detail adds depth without distraction, allowing the proportions, layout, and finishing to remain at the forefront. The result is a piece that feels both contemporary and enduring, defined by precision and restraint. Powering the watch is the ETA 7001 manual wind movement, selected for its slim profile and proven reliability. Its architecture allows the AC2 to retain its characteristic proportions, with a total thickness of 6.65mm including the display caseback. The movement represents a deliberate choice, favoring established, well-understood calibers that support long-term ownership. The stainless steel case is hand-finished, featuring a combination of brushed and mirror-polished surfaces that highlight its form. This same level of attention is applied to the hands and indices, which are carefully finished to ensure clarity, balance, and a refined visual presence. As the brand’s first mechanical offering, the AC2 Volcán Manual Wind is produced in extremely limited quantities, reflecting an intentional approach to production and a closer relationship with collectors. Specifications Case Diameter: 37mm Case Material: Stainless steel, hand-finished with brushed and mirror-polished surfaces Case Thickness: 6.65mm (including display caseback) Lug-to-Lug: 44.6mm Lug Width: 20mm Movement: ETA 7001 manual wind caliber Crystal: Anti-reflective sapphire Water Resistance: 5 ATM Strap: Italian leather strap with stainless steel buckle
